## 01 · Daily at 09:00 UTC or on demand
A scheduled run acts as the steward. On-demand reports require admin access.

## 02 · Check time-driven drift
Re-scan for overdue approvals and refresh the snapshot after B commits its findings.

## 03 · Group actionable issues
Write a daily owner-grouped report and a deduplicated mock Slack outbox. Manual requests return the report.

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { authorization: $json.headers?.authorization ?? null, adminOnly: true } }];

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify($('Read operator identity').isExecuted ? $('Read operator identity').first().json : { system: true }) }}
={{ JSON.stringify({ revision: $('Read post-scan state').first().json.revision, writes: $('Group issues and prepare outbox').first().json.writes }) }}

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: $json.committed ? $('Group issues and prepare outbox').first().json : { httpCode: 409, payload: { status: 'state_changed', message: 'Refresh and retry.' } } }];
return [{ json: $json.actor ? { httpCode: 403, payload: { status: 'denied' } } : { httpCode: 401, payload: { status: 'authentication_required' } } }];
